verdict.rationale: An error-monitoring SaaS could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server lets external agents connect to BugSnag, and rule-based automatic error assignment is non-AI automation; both are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
